sents.t: In America, people give cards, chocolates, and red roses to the people they love.
Children give small cards to all their classmates.
For weeks, I wanted to ask Lily from Maple Café on a date, but I was too shy.
Every morning, I only said, “Thanks, Lily!”
On February 13th, I finally did it.
“Lily, are you free tomorrow evening? Would you like to have dinner with me?”
“I’d love to! I’ll meet you at seven.”
I bought a small box of chocolates and one red rose, and I made a reservation at a little Thai restaurant, because Lily loves spicy food.
At dinner, we talked for three hours.
Lily told me about her family in Seattle and her dream: “One day, I’m going to open my own bakery.”
When I walked her home, she said, “This was perfect. Will you call me tomorrow?”
